visualization.notes: 393 trials lack phase designation (NA), and another 214 are marked not applicable. Among trials with defined phases, Phase 2 (110) is the largest group, followed closely by Phase 4 (107), Phase 1 (101), and Phase 3 (100). Early Phase 1 trials are the fewest with 9 studies.
visualization.query_interpretation: User wants the phase distribution of trials for the condition 'diabetes'. This calls for a distribution query grouped by phase, using query_cond for the condition filter.
